note: Tenth shop of the B07 covered arcade (glass skylight, honey limestone, dark oak joinery, as on the exterior): the print room and bookshop, with deep red damask walls and a blue-grey slate floor. LANDMARK: the huge black iron printing press in the middle. The glazed door on the left shows the florist's greenhouse with its palm (way back); the arch on the right shows the violet perfumery with its bottle shelves (next shop). Feminine nouns on the left, masculine on the right.

items.scene: fresh prints from the PRINTSHOP hang on the line to dry, each a wet IMPRINT
